name: PackRat Smart Lighting for Hue & Govee
headline: Your Hue + Govee lights. One Stream Deck.
description: Control your Philips Hue and Govee lighting through one unified Stream Deck plugin for Windows. Toggle lights and supported Hue rooms or zones with live power feedback. Set fixed brightness and supported color or color-temperature presets, recall supported scenes, and use one-press favorite power workflows across both brands. Stream Deck+ supports dial brightness with current-state feedback, and Neo includes a read-only lighting Infobar. Editable prebuilt layouts for Standard/MK.2, XL, Plus and Neo help get started without assigning invented device IDs. The shared PackRat Lighting Companion runs locally and already powers the separate PackRat XENEON smart lighting widget. Install it once, pair Philips Hue locally and/or discover compatible Govee LAN lights, and paste the local companion pairing token in Stream Deck. Optional Govee Developer API key is configured only inside the Windows companion for devices and scenes that require it. Physical device and feature support varies. Mixed-brand favorites operate on reachable, power-capable devices configured as favorites in the companion/XENEON widget. Hue and Govee logos and endorsements are not implied.
release_notes: • Unified Hue + Govee light power, brightness and supported color/scene controls.\n• One-press mixed-brand favorites, plus live Stream Deck+ brightness dials and display-only Neo status.\n• Editable MK.2, XL, Plus and Neo profiles; reuse the existing secure local PackRat Lighting Companion.
